tasks.prompt: Read the protected API definition and api-test-interface.json without modifying either input. Implement api-test-generator.mjs using the public offline CLI contract. Run it for the given API definition to create generated/api-test-plan.json. Create api-test-report.json and report verification truthfully. Produce exactly the three declared outputs; do not install packages, contact a server, or use the network. Input path: api/openapi.yaml.

fixtures.api/openapi.yaml:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: User API
  version: 1.0.0
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
paths:
  /users:
    post:
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [name, email]
              properties:
                name:
                  type: string
                  minLength: 3
                  maxLength: 40
                email:
                  type: string
                  format: email
                role:
                  type: string
                  enum: [reader, editor]
      responses:
        "201": { description: Created }
        "400": { description: Invalid JSON }
        "401": { description: Unauthorized }
        "422": { description: Validation error }
  /users/{userId}:
    get:
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - in: path
          name: userId
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      responses:
        "200": { description: User }
        "401": { description: Unauthorized }
        "404": { description: Not found }
fixtures.api-test-interface.json:
{
  "schemaVersion": "skill-ir-api-tester-interface/v1",
  "interfaceId": "api-tester-generator-interface-v1",
  "protectedInputs": [
    "<task-openapi-path>",
    "api-test-interface.json"
  ],
  "outputs": [
    "api-test-generator.mjs",
    "generated/api-test-plan.json",
    "api-test-report.json"
  ],
  "generator": {
    "path": "api-test-generator.mjs",
    "command": [
      "node",
      "api-test-generator.mjs",
      "--input",
      "<relative-openapi-path>",
      "--out",
      "<relative-plan-path>"
    ],
    "exitCode": 0,
    "deterministic": true
  },
  "plan": {
    "requiredFields": [
      "schemaVersion",
      "source",
      "framework",
      "endpoints"
    ],
    "endpointFields": [
      "method",
      "path",
      "cases"
    ],
    "caseFields": [
      "id",
      "category",
      "request",
      "expectedStatus",
      "assertions",
      "independent",
      "timeoutMs"
    ],
    "categoryValues": [
      "happy",
      "boundary",
      "error"
    ],
    "allowAdditionalFields": true,
    "allowAnyCaseOrder": true
  },
  "report": {
    "requiredFields": [
      "schemaVersion",
      "discoverySource",
      "generatedCaseCount",
      "verification",
      "limitations"
    ],
    "verificationStatus": [
      "passed",
      "failed",
      "not-run"
    ]
  },
  "resourcePolicy": {
    "network": false,
    "packageInstall": false,
    "allowedRuntime": "node",
    "availablePackages": [
      "yaml"
    ]
  },
  "outputPolicy": {
    "exactOutputSet": true,
    "freeTextLanguage": "any"
  }
}

eval.name: Protected inputs and deterministic generator execution
Cases reflect documented valid, boundary, and invalid inputs
Security and response assertions follow the public API definition
Cases are independent and verification claims are grounded
